correctness.rationale: For any super dominating set, a private leaf and its core cannot both be omitted. Every omitted core in A is witnessed by its selected leaf; every omitted leaf at a core in B needs that core as witness, so it cannot have any adjacent omitted core. Thus the allowed omitted sets are precisely nonconflicting choices. They are downward closed and inclusion-minimality of the selected set is maximality of the omissions. An empty pair at v can add an omitted core iff v has no B-neighbor, and can add an omitted leaf iff it has no A-neighbor. This establishes both directions of the classification, including isolates and disconnected bases. On a cycle the E's are isolated, and every E flips the occupied type across it. Therefore their number is even, say 2j, and the 2j remaining positive runs alternate, requiring 4j<=n. Marking one separator gives n labelled choices, two choices of first type, and binom(n-2j-1,2j-1) ordered run compositions, divided by 2j possible marks. The zero-separator case gives the two constant words; it includes n=3, with no positive j. The resulting support, maximum size and all four residue formulas follow by substitution. A bounded replay from the witness definition agrees, including the C_8 counts 2,40,4 at sizes 8,10,12.
residual_risks: The replay corroborates only the stated finite range. The result above is for labelled subsets, not witness assignments, orbit counts, or the neighborhood corona.

evidence: The arbitrary-pendant-multiplicity theorem identifies admissible profiles as arbitrary omitted cores A and chosen pendants only at V minus N[A]. The all-rung Möbius-ladder theorem gives coefficient (2n/k) binom(k,n-k) for every admissible odd k. The cycle coloring theorem gives the complete distribution by the number of balanced edges for each n.
broader_coverage.reasoning: At one leaf the all-base profile is identical before taking maximal elements. The older results cover the even and odd observable size profiles by exact transformations, not just by analogy or matching small sizes.

evidence: Maximality in the earlier local admissibility model is exactly B=V minus N[A] and A=V minus N[B], which is the two-neighbor rule. For n odd set k=n-2j in the old Möbius formula and complement the size to 2n-k=n+2j. For n even set e=2j and use n-e balanced edges in Theorem 11; its count is 2 binom(n-e-1,e)+4 binom(n-e-1,e-1), equal to (2n/e) binom(n-e-1,e-1) for e>0, and 2 for e=0.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Both branches give the same coefficient n/j times binom(n-2j-1,2j-1) for positive j with exactly the source support. Taking the largest size then gives the extremal formulas by algebra. The exact saturation of the general admissibility rule does not independently supply a nonroutine new invariant.

evidence: Let Q_H have vertices a_v,b_v and edges a_u b_v exactly when u=v or uv is a base edge. The earlier allowable-omission subsets are exactly the independent sets of Q_H; minimal selections therefore correspond by complementation to maximal independent sets of Q_H. For odd n the cross edges with consecutive cycle indices form a single 2n-cycle and the same-index edges join its opposite vertices, giving M_{2n}. For even n there are two n-cycles with same-index rungs, giving the n-prism.

The E-labels in a cyclic profile determine exactly the set of isolated separators (with two phase choices if their count is even). In the integrated-coloring formulation, use the same indices for the unbalanced (equal-color) edges. These edges cannot touch, and an even number of balanced (opposite-color) edges is necessary and sufficient for a return to the starting color.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: For even n the latter parity is precisely even |E|. The two admissible phases on each side give a label-preserving correspondence for the separator/edge subsets and counts by cardinality. For odd n the direct Möbius-ladder isomorphism already covers every configuration and cardinality.

originality.rationale: An older pendant-corona result already gives the exact allowable omissions on every base; the new-looking two-neighbor condition is saturation of those omissions. More importantly, the entire cycle size distribution reduces exactly to earlier enumerations in other formulations: the odd sunlet rows are the reflected independent-domination polynomial of odd-rung Möbius ladders; the even rows are a change of parameter of the established mixing-number distribution for integrated cycle colorings. This also covers the upper cardinality and every claimed optimizer multiplicity. The obstruction is mathematical prior coverage, not an inaccessible source or a flaw in the formulas.
residual_risks: The sources need not have stated the conclusion in super-domination terminology. The coverage follows by explicit graph and cardinality transforms; no assertion is made about who first noticed these connections. No precedence is inferred for nearby same-date path records.

value.rationale: A size-refined classification for this natural family would intrinsically be useful, but all of the claimed new census and extremal information is already accessible through exact earlier results. The remaining all-base local test is an immediate maximality reformulation of the known allowed omissions; it does not add a nonroutine structural or enumerative consequence. A credit correction alone would not leave a distinct valuable theorem to repair.
residual_risks: This decision assesses the supplied classification and census, not the usefulness of a future new invariant about leaf coronas or ladders.
